entities.name: Mindaugas Sinkevičius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mindaugas Sinkevičius is a Lithuanian manager and politician, who is currently serving as Acting Chairman of the Social Democratic Party of Lithuania since July 2025. He also served as Mayor of Jonava District Municipality, former Minister of Economy of Lithuania (2016–2017) and Vice-Mayor of Jonava (2008–2011).

entities.summary: Mindaugas Sinkevičius is a Lithuanian manager and politician, who is currently serving as Acting Chairman of the Social Democratic Party of Lithuania since July 2025. He also served as Mayor of Jonava District Municipality, former Minister of Economy of Lithuania (2016–2017) and Vice-Mayor of Jonava (2008–2011).
